title: ToySVG: Benchmarking Geometric Perception and Vector Reconstruction Under Parsimony Budgets
description:
ToySVG is a deterministic benchmark evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on geometric visual perception and raster-to-vector SVG path reconstruction under explicit command budgets.

Features include exact closed-form geometric scoring (soft IoU, symmetric Chamfer boundary fidelity, Euler topological conservation) with zero judge models in the evaluation loop, leakage-mitigated split architecture, and integration with official Kaggle Benchmarks tasks.
